releases.notes:
- Fix syncing config between server and client
- Minor internal optimization regarding config changes on a server.
- Prevent Fake Players from interacting with Instant Pickup
- Extend Taggable Players to allow forcing certain players to have a feature in config.
- Update /Fabrication, /Forgery command to allow refering features like this : ".feature" instead of "*.feature"
- Add scriting support to instant_pickup
- Fix malformed Block Logo config crash
